data_sources.dataset: IBKR paper account top-of-book quotes for SPY, read by the desk owner at entry and while watching the exit
data_sources.name: ibkr-paper-quotes
data_sources.provenance: Read live through the paper gateway by the desk equity path (Wave 2); not recorded as a dataset. The paper account's market data entitlement is NOT verified by this draft, so quotes are treated as possibly delayed (realtime false). Fills, commissions and positions come from the reconciled paper ledger, not from this feed.

decision_rule.statement: This control has no signal; it measures what the desk mechanics, the exit policy and paper costs alone produce. Entry: the first NYSE session of each calendar week, a whole-share long SPY DAY limit order sized to at most 1,000.00 USD notional, proposed after 10:00 ET and sent only if the owner approves it. Exit: stop 2% below the entry limit (desk-watched), no target, deadline the third session after entry, forced exit 15:45 ET. Metric: mean net P&L in cents per completed lifecycle (C3.4 definition, commissions included) from the reconciled paper ledger. Read once, together with the challenger, when both have at least 20 completed lifecycles and at least 60 sessions have passed since the later seal.

hypothesis: Control: a scheduled, signal-free SPY entry with the pilot's fixed exit policy sets the per-lifecycle outcome the challenger must beat. No edge is expected or claimed for the control itself.
title: SPY weekly scheduled entry (equity control)
